name: LinkedIn Mentions (via Apify)
author: hearth-team
description: Keyword search across ALL of LinkedIn — finds posts that mention a phrase, by anyone. Use this for 'find posts about X' or 'who's posting about Y'. NOT for 'what did <specific person> post' — use linkedin_profile_posts for that. Returns posts with author + URL + snippet. Reuses APIFY_API_TOKEN.

vault_inputs.label: Apify API Token
vault_inputs.help: Same token as the generic Apify Actor skill — paste once, used here too. Console → Settings → Integrations → API.

family.name: Apify Family
family.description: Web, social, and data scraping via Apify's actor library. One API token unlocks all 18 specialized scrapers.
